verdict.rationale: PlanetScale provides a CLI and API to create, delete, and list databases and branches programmatically (planetscale-docs-41, planetscale-docs-49) and supports branch-based isolation for dev/test/preview environments (planetscale-docs-9, planetscale-docs-10, planetscale-docs-32), which fits an agent-per-branch or tenant-per-branch pattern. However, there is no evidence describing per-unit pricing or architecture optimized for spinning up *thousands* of cheap isolated databases at scale — usage-based pricing comments raise cost concerns (planetscale-comm-11) and one report shows database creation being throttled under load (planetscale-comm-12), undermining the 'cheap at massive scale' claim. Missing for 10: documented low/zero-cost per-branch pricing at scale, evidence of thousands of concurrent isolated DBs in production, and confirmation that quota/creation limits don't block agent-driven fleets.
